title: Email a receipt from your Zoho mailbox
summary: When an invoice is paid in full, email the customer a thank-you receipt from your own Zoho Mail address.
description: Whenever one of your invoices is paid in full and the customer gave an email address, Taskiem emails them a short receipt from your own Zoho Mail mailbox: the invoice number, the amount and a thank-you, so it comes from you rather than from Taskiem. One receipt for each invoice.

params.name: mail_connection
params.title: Zoho Mail connection
params.description: Your Zoho mailbox, connected with one click.

definition.name: Email a receipt from Zoho Mail

input.subject: ='Receipt for invoice ' + trigger.body.number
input.text:
='Dear ' + trigger.body.customer.name + ',

Thank you: we have received ' + trigger.body.amount + ' for invoice ' + trigger.body.number + ', which is now paid in full.' + (has(trigger.body.fee) ? ' Of what you sent, the bank kept a fee of ' + trigger.body.fee + ' and ' + trigger.body.received + ' reached us.' : '') + '

' + steps.settings.output.business_name
